transcript.message: Hi! My client needs a compact tractor for mowing 6 acres of pasture and clearing snow — the T25 looks like the right fit. We'd like it with the front loader and delivery/setup. We're ready to buy quickly. Would you do the package for $28,000?

Thanks for reaching out. The T25 is a great match for 6 acres of mowing and snow clearing. $28,000 is below the list price of the tractor by itself, so I can't make that work for the full package. Here's the package you asked for at list: T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader (60-inch bucket) and delivery with on-site setup and walkthrough, for $35,900 total. If your client is ready to move quickly, we can get this scheduled right away.

Understood. $28,000 was aggressive. Still, $35,900 is full list on everything, and we're a ready, quick-close buyer bundling two add-ons. A reasonable package discount would be to waive delivery and take some off the loader. Could you do $30,000 for the T25 with the loader and delivery/setup? We can sign today.

I appreciate that your client is ready to move quickly, and I want to get this done. $30,000 is too far from where we are on this package, so I can't waive delivery or take that much off the loader. I can come down to $35,800 for the T25 Compact with the quick-attach front loader (60-inch bucket) and delivery within 150 miles, including on-site setup and a walkthrough. If that works for your client, we can get it scheduled today.

Thanks for moving a bit, but $100 off a $35,900 package doesn't really change the picture. Let me be straightforward: the full package at that price doesn't fit my client's numbers. One option is to drop delivery and let my client arrange transport. Another is for us to meet on the full bundle. I'll come up to $30,500 for the T25 with the loader and delivery/setup. That's a firm, ready-to-sign number today, and it gets a quick, clean sale off your lot.

I appreciate you being straightforward, and I'll be straightforward too. I can come down another $200, to $35,600, for the full package: the T25 Compact, the quick-attach front loader with 60-inch bucket, and delivery within 150 miles with on-site setup and a walkthrough. Your client could also drop delivery and arrange their own transport if that fits their budget better. Just let me know and I'll put that option together. Otherwise, we're ready to schedule this package today.

I appreciate the movement, but at $100-200 per round we're not going to get there, and I'd rather be direct than waste your time. My client's ceiling for this purchase is close to where I've been. The full package at $35,600 isn't workable, and dropping delivery still leaves T25 plus loader at $35,000 list, which is just as far off. My best number for the full package, T25 with loader and delivery/setup, is $30,800, ready to sign today. If the loader margin is the sticking point, tell me what you could do on the T25 with delivery and setup alone, and I'll take that back to my client.

I appreciate the directness, and I'll match it. I'm coming down $400 from my last offer, to $35,200 for the full package: the T25 Compact, the quick-attach front loader with 60-inch bucket, and delivery within 150 miles with on-site setup and a walkthrough. That's my biggest move so far. I understand there's still a gap to your number, but this is a solid package for your client's 6 acres and snow work. If it works, we can sign and schedule today.

Thanks, I appreciate the bigger move. Realistically, though, the loader package can't get under my client's ceiling at these numbers. Let's do a deal we can both close today: the T25 Compact with delivery and on-site setup, no loader. List on that is $29,400. I'll offer $28,900, and we're ready to sign and schedule immediately. My client can add a loader later.

That works for us. We accept $28,900 for the T25 Compact with delivery within 150 miles, on-site setup, and a walkthrough. Payment is due at checkout, and once that's done we'll get delivery scheduled right away. If your client decides to add the quick-attach front loader later, just reach out and we'll be glad to help.
